full_page.content:
1954, March 25
The following is a faithful transcription of the handwritten Original by the Servant of God, Father Solanus Casey, O. F.M. Cap.
ST. FELIX FRIARY HUNTINGTON, INDIANA March 25 - 1954 Feast of The Anninciation
Blessed be God in all His designs.
My Dear Brother - Rt. Rev. Edw'd F. J. - Greetings -
Congratulations on your practical Write in the "Priest." Too bad you could'nt have it in a hundred publications.
Miss Beatrice McCahill was over from Chicago, 7612 N. Ashland. She promised a $100 for your Seminary some time ago if she got a certain favor. Here with you'll find same. Delighted to give the surprise. I am trying to get it off To-Day.
God help us! I hardly seem to be getting anything done - any- yet so much to be done. I am often at my wits' end what to do first. .... God bless us all.
Fr. Solanus, O.F.M.Cap. Glory be to God!
March 30th
God bless you Fr. Ed.
I hope this finds you well. I've not been too well now for a good week. But thank God I've been able to say holy Mass. We hope to see the Crisi in the Mercy Hall Hospital case, Detroit very soon. - -- Her Enemies have hesitated at nothing to put over their lies.
-- Glory be to God!
Fr. Solanus, O.F.M.Cap.
